title: Toward Circuit-Aware Mutation Testing for Quantum Programs: Exact Visibility and Execution Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mutation testing assesses test suites by introducing program changes and checking whether tests detect them. In quantum programs, a surviving mutant may leave program behavior unchanged, produce a change hidden by the chosen input or measurement, or remain undetected because statistical evidence is insufficient. We develop a circuit-aware framework to distinguish these causes and guide execution planning and test changes. The framework covers ideal, noiseless programs and mutations that replace one gate or subcircuit. The method traces how a mutation can affect measured outputs and combines established mathematical checks with statistical estimates. For supported cases, we establish conditions under which a test cannot reveal a mutation and exact formulas for its effect when the required state information is available. translated_title: 面向量子程序的电路感知变异测试：精确可见性与执行规划
translated_abstract: 变异测试通过向程序引入变更并检查测试是否能检测到这些变更来评估测试套件的质量。在量子程序中，一个存活的变异体可能源于以下几种情况：变异没有改变程序行为、产生的变更被所选的输入或测量所隐藏、或者由于统计证据不足而未被检测到。我们开发了一个电路感知框架来区分这些不同的原因，并据此指导执行规划和测试变更。该框架涵盖理想的、无噪声的程序，以及替换单个门或子电路的变异。该方法追踪变异如何影响测量输出，并将已有的数学检查与统计估计相结合。对于所支持的案例，我们建立了测试无法揭示变异的条件，以及在所需量子态信息可用时描述变异影响的精确公式。在给定假设下，我们在保留存活变异体和未解决变异体的同时对变异得分进行界定，并识别……
tldr: 提出了一种面向量子程序的电路感知变异测试框架，能够精确区分变异体存活的三种原因（等价变异、被输入或测量隐藏的变更、统计证据不足），并给出测试无法揭示变异的条件与变异影响的精确公式，从而指导执行规划和测试改进。
en_tdlr: A circuit-aware mutation testing framework for quantum programs that exactly distinguishes why mutants survive—equivalent behavior, changes hidden by inputs or measurements, or insufficient statistical evidence—and provides provable detection conditions and exact effect formulas to guide execution planning and test improvement.
